segments.text: Comparing the ix.viii.v-p10.2 with chapters xxv. and xxvi. of these ix.viii.v-p10.3, it seems to me that the nature of the eucharistic (thanksgiving) prayers becomes apparent. They presuppose the formulas to be found in the eighth book of the ix.viii.v-p10.4, and are such instructions as were imparted only to catechumens; the part peculiar to presbyters being withheld, of course, as esoteric mysteries, until further knowledge was canonically appropriate. See Elucidation IV. vol. vi. p. 236; and in this volume, Elucidation I. p. 382. The Bryennios ms. is cleared from nearly all difficulties by Dr. Riddle’s lucid notes, when compared with corresponding passages in the ix.viii.v-p11.9, or illustrated by such as are supplementary.
